=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh:161-166 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The retry_hours validation runs `$((10#${retry_hours}))` before it checks the range, so a digit-only value of 2^63 or more (e.g. `9223372036854775808`) overflows and skips the `-gt 23` fallback.
  WHY: With the bad value, `[ "${retry_hours}" -gt 0 ]` on line 173 is false, so deferral turns off with no `::warning::` and no fallback to the documented default 2; all reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low).
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:887-892 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: On a durable-cache hit, verifyTrustedSha calls `rememberVerifiedSha(sha, now)`, which stores the time of the read instead of the original verification time `durableAt`.
  WHY: A durable entry read just before its 7-day TTL expires stays trusted in that isolate's memory for up to another 6 hours (VERIFIED_SHA_TTL_MS), past the documented 7-day bound (≈7.24 days); rated NIT (mapped to low). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:564-577 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: verifiedShaMap and the durable helpers (lines 805, 831) call `isPlainObject` and `isNumber`, which the reviewer says are neither imported nor defined.
  WHY: If true, this causes a ReferenceError when SHAs are cached or retrieved; rated BLOCKER (mapped to critical). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute it: `isNumber` is defined at index.ts:260-263 using `Number.isFinite`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The fragment is present but has no "The numbers that matter" table, the measurable values (7-day TTL, 256-entry cap, default `2` retry hours, 2-hour deferral window, `0` opt-out) appear only in prose, comparable fragments (`changelog.d/9252-epochrealtime-ms-clock.md`, `changelog.d/9215-bash-clock-ms-timers.md`, `changelog.d/9528-ci-once-at-end-of-review.md`, ~50 others) include the table, and the "What this means for <audience>" paragraph is present (all rated NIT). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes the gap: CLAUDE.md §20 item 3 says "Omit it when nothing measurable improves the entry".
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh:lines 161-166, `if ! [[ "${retry_hours}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || [ "$((10#${retry_hours}))" -gt 23 ]; then ... retry_hours=$((10#${retry_hours}))` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The value goes through Bash arithmetic before its range is checked, so a digit-only value of 2^63 or more wraps to a negative number and skips the warning and the fallback to 2.
  WHY: The negative value fails `[ "${retry_hours}" -gt 0 ]` on line 173, so deferral turns off with no `::warning::`. Suggested fix: check the length first, e.g. `[ "${#retry_hours}" -le 2 ]`.
- HARDENING: tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts verifyTrustedSha durable-hit branch (`rememberVerifiedSha(sha, now);` around line 889): the memory cache stores the read time, so an entry can stay trusted up to 6h past the 7-day bound. Suggested fix: store `Math.min(now, durableAt + DURABLE_VERIFIED_SHA_TTL_MS - VERIFIED_SHA_TTL_MS)` (1-2 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh line 162: add `|| [ "${#retry_hours}" -gt 2 ]` before the arithmetic comparison (1 line).
- Dismissed pass-1 claims: "isNumber undefined/too weak" is invalid (index.ts:260-263 uses `Number.isFinite`). Three task gaps were dropped: the changelog table is optional under §20 item 3, the fragment entry was only a confirmation, and constant-name uniqueness is not a gap (3 related items).
- All other lenses NONE. TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:lines 887-892 (the durable-hit branch in `verifyTrustedSha`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: After a durable hit, `rememberVerifiedSha(sha, now)` stores the read time instead of the original `verifiedAt`, so the in-memory cache trusts the SHA for another `VERIFIED_SHA_TTL_MS` (6 hours).
  WHY: The memory-cache branch at lines 878-885 keeps returning `trusted` after the durable entry is older than 7 days, so total trust can reach `DURABLE_VERIFIED_SHA_TTL_MS + VERIFIED_SHA_TTL_MS` (≈7.24 days).
- scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh:lines 161-166 (the `retry_hours` validation block in `daily_usage_send`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `[ "$((10#${retry_hours}))" -gt 23 ]` runs Bash arithmetic on regex-accepted digits, so a value of 2^63 or more overflows and the fallback branch is never entered.
  WHY: The `-gt 0` check on line 173 then errors or evaluates false, so deferral turns off without falling back to 2. `test_send_invalid_retry_hours_falls_back_to_two` only tests `"abc"` and `"24"`.
